name: Artistly
description_en:
Artistly combines prompt-based image creation with editing tools for backgrounds, inpainting, upscaling, mockups and illustrated content. Its page also promotes consistent characters and storybook production, with several capabilities assigned to a higher-priced plan.

This is an image production service, not a promise of exclusive artwork or publication acceptance. The lifetime and unlimited language needs to be read with the service terms and plan-specific entitlements.
description_zh:
Artistly 结合提示生成及背景、局部修改、放大、样机和插画工具，另宣传一致角色及故事书，多项能力属于高价层。

这是图片生产服务，不保证独占作品或出版接受；终身、不限等表述需结合条款及套餐权益阅读。

core_features.explanation_en: Generate, replace backgrounds, inpaint and upscale within a hosted workflow.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在托管流程生成、换背景、局部修改及放大。

core_features.explanation_en: Premium lists character consistency and storybook-related features.
core_features.explanation_zh: Premium 列角色一致性及故事书能力。

en: Prepare a checked product mockup from an authorized design.
zh: 从获授权设计准备已核产品样机。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Confirm the purchased tier, generate one authorized mockup and inspect full-size details and rights before distribution.
steps.zh: 确认购买层，生成获授权样机，分发前核全尺寸细节及权利。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: One-time hosted-service license with plan entitlements and fair use.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Commercial $49/Premium $147 one-time; upgrade $97. FAQ 400 generations/day fair use; lifetime tied to product lifespan and changing limits. Thirty-day landing refund conflicts with main terms.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Commercial 一次 $49/Premium $147，升级 $97。FAQ 每日 400 合理使用；终身限产品生命周期且可调整。首页 30 天退款与主条款冲突。

sources.title: Artistly: All-in-One AI Image Generator - Text-to-Image
sources.research_notes_en: Image/editing/storybook suite, distinct Commercial and Premium entitlements; marketing unlimited has 400/day FAQ cap.

sources.title: Artistly: All-in-One AI Image Generator - Text-to-Image
sources.research_notes_en: Same official landing page: $49 Commercial/$147 Premium one-time, upgrade $97, advertised refund conflicts with terms.

sources.title: Artistly.ai – Terms of Service
sources.research_notes_en: Single-user service and lifetime addendum: commercial lifespan, variable resource limits, no guaranteed future features or exclusive output.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Inspect a complete asset rather than a thumbnail
sections.title_zh: 检查完整素材而非缩略图
sections.en: For an illustrative product mockup, provide an authorized logo and inspect edges, lettering, proportions and product details at export size. A generated scene may look persuasive while changing the actual product. Storybooks additionally need page-by-page continuity, language and print checks; a claimed 300-DPI PDF does not guarantee marketplace acceptance.
sections.zh: 例如产品样机，应使用获授权标志，并在输出尺寸核边缘、文字、比例及产品细节。场景好看仍可能改变真实产品；故事书另需逐页核连续性、语言和印刷，300 DPI PDF 宣传不保证平台接受。

sections.title_en: Compare the two plans and qualified unlimited claim
sections.title_zh: 比较双套餐及有条件不限
sections.en: The landing page lists Commercial at $49 one-time and Premium at $147, with a $97 in-app upgrade. It alternates personal/commercial labels and broadly says everything included while marking several tools Premium. The FAQ limits fair use to 400 image generations/day. Confirm the exact checkout entitlement instead of assuming the $49 banner buys every displayed feature.
sections.zh: 首页 Commercial 一次 $49、Premium $147，应用内升级 $97；个人/商用标签交替，泛称全包含却又标多项 Premium。FAQ 合理使用上限每日 400 次，应确认结算权益，不能把 $49 当全部展示功能。

sections.title_en: Read lifetime as the product’s commercial lifespan
sections.title_zh: 终身指产品商业生命周期
sections.en: The addendum allows changing resource limits, excludes guaranteed future features and permits end-of-life termination. Its high-cost-user clause can require a subscription/overage arrangement. The landing page advertises a thirty-day refund while the main terms say fees nonrefundable except legally required; resolve that conflict before payment. Single-user accounts cannot be shared.
sections.zh: 附录允许调整资源限制，不保证未来功能，产品结束可终止；高成本用户条款可要求订阅或超额安排。首页宣传 30 天退款，主条款却称除法律要求外不退，付款前需澄清。账户单人且不可共享。

sections.title_en: Commercial permission does not guarantee exclusivity
sections.en: The vendor allows commercial use subject to rights and terms, while the addendum disclaims uniqueness, copyrightability and non-infringement. Review source-image rights and likeness consent, especially before public distribution. Evaluate one small export and its plan terms first. No image, print file, face tool, purchase or refund was tested; no source license or self-hosted package was verified.
sections.zh: 厂商按条款允许商用，但附录不保证唯一、版权成立或无侵权。公开前应核输入权利及肖像同意，先测小输出及对应权益。本文未测图片、印刷、脸部、付款或退款，未核源码许可/自托管。

research_gaps: No generation, consistency, print acceptance, purchase or refund tested.
Refund conflict, actual entitlement, future features, data retention, source license and self-hosting unresolved.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
